sections.Profile:
The Camelot and Galahad pinball machines were released by Bally in 1970. These two games are almost identical, with Camelot being the four-player version and Galahad the two-player version. Both were designed by Ted Zale and featured artwork by Christian Marche, with a medieval theme centered around the Knights of the Round Table.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1970
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
